articles.title: A Landslide in Alaska Made a Giant Tsunami
articles.summary: Scientists say warning signs came before a landslide made a record-high tsunami in Alaska.

articles.title: Scientists Find Missing Matter Hiding Around Galaxies
articles.summary: Flashes of radio waves helped scientists find thin gas clouds holding some of the universe's missing matter.

articles.title: New Tattoo Ink Can Vanish and Come Back
articles.summary: Scientists made tattoo ink that fades under UV light and comes back in normal light.
